karats.label: 24k
karats.blurb: Our 24k gold leaf is 99.9% gold, available as transfer and loose leaf books and in heavier double, triple and quad leaf. 24 karat gold is especially popular for gilding projects which require purity and durability, especially outdoor projects and religious iconography.

karats.label: 23.75k
karats.blurb: Our 23.75k gold leaf has a slightly softer tone when compared to our 24k gold leaf. It comes in transfer leaf and loose leaf books, and in standard, double, and triple leaf. Our triple leaf is ideal for all outdoor applications.

karats.label: 23k
karats.blurb: 23k gold leaf is one of the more popular colors. We have it in transfer and loose leaf books, in both standard and double leaf, from Voltarra and from Noris, plus a red gold.

karats.label: 22k
karats.blurb: 22k gold leaf is 91.8% gold with silver and copper added, which gives it a lighter color than leaf with a higher gold content. Moon gold and rose gold are also 22 karat.

karats.label: 18k
karats.blurb: 18k gold leaf is an alloy of 75% gold and 25% silver, which gives the leaf a bright yellow color. Because of the high silver content, 18k leaf must be sealed to keep it from tarnishing.

karats.label: 12k
karats.blurb: 12k gold leaf is 51% real gold with silver and palladium added, which produces a silver-colored leaf with a touch of color, also known as white gold. It must be sealed to keep it from tarnishing.
